properties.comment: Lake Region Electric will have a planned power outage on Thursday, October 22nd beginning at 10 am and will last until approximately 1:30 pm.  Services affected will be between 113th and 114th Street and Buhl Lakeview Rd and between 434th and 436th Avenue.  If you work from home or have a medical condition that requires electricity, we request that you relocate during the outage or use backup generation.   We appreciate your patience.  Thank you.
